application.source: classification mapping required by the facts audit brief

chemistry.note: Neither the release nor its paper or record states the cell chemistry.

units_released.note: Rule: the 28 vehicles with battery signals: the 27 of the PHEV and EV workbook and vehicle 439, listed as an HEV but carrying battery signals (maintainer, 2026-10-13); the other 356 are held but not units. Released unit identifiers require package-specific inspection.

cells_liion.note: The release gives pack- or system-level signals and no cell topology.

cells_leadacid.note: No lead-acid cell count applies or is exposed in this release.

cell_channels_measured.note: No individual cell-voltage channels are released.

energy_mwh.source: https://github.com/gsoh/VED, README ('2013 Nissan Leaf with an advertised battery capacity of 24 kWh')
energy_mwh.note: The 3 EVs only. The 24 PHEVs and vehicle 439 have no stated rating; 13 PHEVs are computable from the data (reports/checks/v12/ved_energy.csv) but are not added, one basis per release.

span_unit_years.note: 28 units: the 27 PHEV and EV and vehicle 439 (maintainer, 2026-10-13); unit-years is first to last DayNum per vehicle, summed; 356 ICE and HEV vehicles are held but not units

obs_hours.note: Calendar spans are measurable, so observation-hours are not used.

fault_onset_timestamp.source: docs/descriptor/TABLE3_faults.md; released labels and metadata contain no explicit fault-onset timestamp field

sentinels_documented.source: https://github.com/gsoh/VED; public data record and released documentation state no sentinel convention
